name: numerals-in-rain
question: Apart from the single time readout on each screen, does any screen show an Arabic numeral 0-9 anywhere, including among the falling glyphs?

name: one-always-on
question: Is exactly one screen black apart from a time readout, with no falling glyphs on it at all?

name: rain-colours
question: Does the falling rain differ in colour from screen to screen, with at least three different colours among the screens, such as green, red and blue?

name: hollow-time
question: Is at least one time readout drawn as outlines only, hollow digits with the background showing through them?

name: added-content
question: Does any screen show anything besides falling glyphs and one time readout, such as a date, seconds, icons, a battery or any other text?

name: added-text
question: Leaving aside the markings printed on the watches themselves, such as GARMIN, START or LAP on the bezels, is there any text, logo, caption or watermark anywhere in the image?
